Special Meeting - City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meetings
AGENDA
MEETING OF
THE LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL AND
SUCCESSOR AGENCY
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
JUNE 7, 2018
07:30
P.M.
Agenda 6-7-18
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL/AGENCY MEMBERS: Lewis, Holloway, Argudo, Munoz and Solis
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
Pursuant to Government Code Section 54954.3(a), you may only address the City Council concerning any item that has been described in the notice for the special meeting. Please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speakerâ€™s remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843.)
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1451
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. 18-5417 approving Warrant Register No. 1451.
D-1 Warrants Resolution #1451
D-2
SECOND READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 18-956 REPEALING CHAPTER 5.36 (MASSAGE ESTABLISHMENTS) OF TITLE 5 (BUSINESS REGULATION AND LICENSES) AND ADDING SECTION 10.50.210 (MASSAGE REGULATIONS) TO CHAPTER 10.50 (STANDARDS FOR SPECIFIC LAND USES AND ACTIVITIES) OF ARTICLE 4 (REGULATIONS FOR SPECIFIC LAND USE ACTIVITIES) OF TITLE 10 (ZONING), AND AMENDING SECTIONS 10.132.140 (â€œMâ€ DEFINITIONS) AND 10.132.170 (â€œPâ€ DEFINITIONS) OF CHAPTER 10.132 DEFINITIONS OF TITLE 10 (ZONING) OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE TO ESTABLISH REGULATIONS FOR MASSAGE ESTABLISHMENTS IN THE CITY, AND NOTICE OF EXEMPTION REGARDING SAME
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) adopt Ordinance No. 18-956, an Ordinance of the City Council of the City of La Puente repealing chapter 5.36 (Massage Establishments) of Title 5 (Business Regulation and Licenses) and adding section 10.50.210 (Massage Regulations) to Chapter 10.50 (Standards for Specific Land Uses and Activities) of Article 4 (Regulations for Specific Land Use Activities) of Title 10 (Zoning), and amending Sections 10.132.140 (â€œMâ€ Definitions) and 10.132.170 (â€œPâ€ Definitions) of chapter 10.132 Definitions of Title 10 (Zoning) of the La Puente Municipal Code to establish regulations for massage establishments in the city; and (2) approve and adopt the Notice of Exemption.
D-2 Massage Regulations Staff Report
D-2 Massage Regulations Attachment A Ordinance
D-2 Massage Regulations Attachment B NOE
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION SUPPORTING THE UNITED WAY â€œEVERYONE INâ€ CAMPAIGN TO HELP END HOMELESSNESS
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 18-5418 supporting the United Way â€œEveryone Inâ€ campaign to help end homelessness.
D-3 United Way Everyone In Staff Report
D-3 United Way Everyone In Attachment A Resolution
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTIONS PERTAINING TO THE CITYâ€™S GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION ON TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 6, 2018
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) adopt Resolution No. 18-5419 calling for the holding of a general municipal election on Tuesday, November 6, 2018; (2) adopt Resolution No. 18-5420 requesting that the County of Los Angeles consolidate the general municipal election with the Statewide general election; and (3) adopt Resolution No. 18-5421 adopting regulations for candidates for elective office pertaining to candidates statements.
D-4 2018 Election Staff Report
D-4 2018 Election Attachment A Resolution Calling for Election
D-4 2018 Election Attachment B Resolution re Consolidation
D-4 2018 Election Attachment C Candidate Statements
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF APPOINTMENTS TO THE PLANNING COMMISSION
It is recommended that the City Council appoint the two qualified applicants to the Planning Commission.
D-5 Planning Commission Appointments Staff Report
D-6
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION RESCINDING RESOLUTION NO. 15-5245, AND REINSTATING THE CITYâ€™S BUSINESS LICENSE FEE FOR VENDORS AT THE LA PUENTE LIVE MARKET
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 18-5422, rescinding Resolution No. 15-5245, thereby requiring La Puente Live market vendors to pay the business license fee set forth in the Cityâ€™s Code.
D-6 La Puente Live Fees Staff Report
D-6 La Puente Live Fees Attachment A Resolution
D-7
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION DESIGNATING THE ENTITIES PERMITTED TO SELL SAFE AND SANE FIREWORKS IN THE CITY AND THE APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS FOR THE SALE OF SAFE AND SANE FIREWORKS
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 18-5423 designating the entities permitted to sell safe and sane fireworks in the City and the application requirements for the sale of fireworks.
D-7 Safe and Sane Fireworks Staff Report
D-7 Safe and Sane Fireworks Attachment A Resolution
D-8
CONSIDERATION OF A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH TRAFFIC MANAGEMENT, INC. FOR SPECIAL EVENT TRAFFIC CONTROL AND RELATED SERVICES IN THE AMOUNT OF $159,729.75
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the Professional Services Agreement with Traffic Management Inc., in the amount of $159,729.75; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City.
D-8 TMI Special Event Traffic Control Staff Report
D-8 TMI Special Event Traffic Control Attachment A Agreement
D-9
CONSIDERATION OF A LETTER IN OPPOSITION TO AB 1912 - PUBLIC EMPLOYEESâ€™ RETIREMENT: JOINT POWERS AGREEMENTS: LIABILITY
It is recommended that the City Council approve the letter of opposition to AB 1912 and authorize the Mayor to sign the letter on its behalf.
D-9 AB 1912 Opposition Staff Report
D-9 AB 1912 Opposition Attachment A Letter
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
PRESENTATION, DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2018/2019 RECOMMENDED BUDGET
It is recommended that the City Council review and discuss the Fiscal Year 2018/2019 Recommended Budget.
E-1 FY 2018-19 Preliminary Budget
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
